summary: Build practical global HRM controls, risk registers, and ethical labour processes. Enrol in five-day labour law compliance training.
lede: Labour law compliance in HRM helps HR practitioners and employee-relations teams map employment obligations and document consistent controls. Participants learn to build compliance matrices, review worker classification and working-time controls, and plan grievance handling. The course also covers non-discrimination monitoring, third-party labour-risk assessment, corrective-action tracking, and leadership reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage employment obligations, workforce risk, ethical conduct, and employee relations across countries, entities, or complex operating models. It suits experienced HR practitioners who need a structured compliance method and senior decision-makers who oversee people governance.
prerequisites: Previous experience in HR operations, employee relations, compliance, payroll, workforce governance, or people management is recommended. You should be comfortable reading internal HR policies and working with basic workforce records. No programming is required. The course addresses internationally recognized principles and risk methods, while jurisdiction-specific legal advice remains outside scope. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted hiring analytics and automated compliance monitoring are taught at operational application level, with implementation depth limited to workflow design, control selection, and dashboard planning.
